lastText: STAVKASVODKAHome19141915191619171918HARD MODE — EROSION 1/4-6MANPOWER-10MUNITIONS+1HOME STABILITYI.1917Out, Early, and AloneAn approach is made before the capital goes, from an empire that still has a front and a government and an army in some order. The terms available are bad. They are better than March 1918's, and they cost the alliance permanently. The territory conceded is territory. The alternative on the present trajectory is the same territory conceded later by people with nothing to offer.Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. Separate-peace soundings existed and none came to anything. The obstacle was never arithmetic. It was that the dynasty could not sign such a thing and remain the dynasty.Return to file
